rejections.name: PV array voltage
rejections.reason: Prose, "must never exceed 150 Voc", repeating the rated "PV Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) 150 Vdc maximum" held under its own name.

rejections.name: Voltage per cell
rejections.reason: No cell voltage is rated under that name: the 2.2 Vpc is a resting state of charge, "a battery at 52.8 Vdc (2.2 Vpc) will be at 100% SoC" (p8), and the 2.11 Vpc a commissioning threshold, "individual cell voltage less than 2.11 Vpc), apply a freshening charge" (p25).
